teaser: Design the wire from what the reader sees: every name a link with a long-lived ID, every sentence a claim, stories of stories, folders by gravity.
core_idea: Designing backwards from the reader, each wire story should be a short narrative in which every name links to a typed, long-lived random ID and every sentence is a typed claim with evidence, with runs, captures, claims, stories, stories of stories and names as the primitives; measured on the four public wire vaults, 202 stories list 1,358 names of which 171 recur across stories, 48 across wires and only 44% appear in the text, so IDs, spans and merges are the work, a name earns a folder by gravity, linking a 55-word narrative avoids the earlier too-much experiments, and cheap models extract while a capable model checks.
